verdict.rationale: llamafile ships an HTTP server and API, so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for it. The evidence never mentions API keys, tokens, or per-agent scopes. The documented server sandbox (no outbound network via `anet`) is process isolation, an adjacent control rather than a least-privilege credential system.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
